title: Percentage: 25% of 60
subject: math
strengths: Most of the class can read 25% as 25 out of 100 on the hundred-grid.
The class can simplify 25% to one quarter before finding a percent of a quantity.

modelAnswers.question: Write 25% as a fraction in its simplest form and explain the step.
modelAnswers.answer: 25% = 25/100 = 1/4: divide the top and the bottom by 25.

modelAnswers.question: Work out 25% of 60, showing the quarter step.
modelAnswers.answer: 25% is one quarter, and 60 / 4 = 15, so 25% of 60 = 15.

commonErrors.example: A learner answers 25 for 25% of 60 on the worksheet, pointing at the 25 in 25% as the answer.

fixIt.prompt: Fix it: shade twenty-five cells out of one hundred on the hundred-grid, then say what the 25 counts out of.
fixIt.corrected: Corrected working: 25% is 25 out of 100, which is one quarter, and one quarter of 60 is 15.

commonErrors.example: On the exit ticket, a learner defends 25 by saying the question already gives the number 25.

fixIt.prompt: Fix it: name the two different wholes in the question - the hundred the percent counts out of, and the 60 the share is taken of.
fixIt.corrected: Corrected check: the 25 counts out of one hundred while the whole here is 60, so the answer is a share of 60, which is 15.

nextSteps: Reteach the per-hundred reading with the hundred-grid before any further percent-of-quantity questions.
Practise simplifying familiar percents to fractions until turning a percent into a fraction of the whole is automatic.
